svg.title: The gap under a QFN and under a BGA
svg.desc: Enlarged and drawn to scale, side views. Left: a QFN sits on its soldered pads only about 0.05 mm above the board, leaving almost no room for cleaning fluid to get under it. Right: a BGA's solder balls hold it about 0.3 mm above the board, leaving a gap the fluid can reach and rinse.

g.text: Hold the BGA about 0.3 mm up
Enlarged and drawn to scale (gaps approximate).
Give parts on washed boards as much clearance underneath as you can (PCB-DFA-057).
